entry_basis: first recorded bid/ask candle open at entry_at; exact minute boundaries only; entry_at must equal confirming candle close
execution_costs: assumed commissions; .25 spread adverse entry/target/time fill slippage; .5 spread on stops; current swap proxy modes 1/5 only; stress doubles spreads/adverse costs and removes swap credits
gaps: incomplete unless continuous coverage proves the outcome; no inferred broker calendar
ties: contiguous M1 required; both barriers within one minute remain ambiguous
unseen_data_status: chronological held-out historical data already exposed to prior research; prospective results required
multiple_testing: pooled across all labs and registered variants; Holm recomputed by control plane; weekly sign-flip symmetry is an assumption
qualification: metrics never certify profitability; independent review and CEO approval mandatory; production activation disabled
